cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 names three systems run wholly by government staff; the citizen portal and data exchange platform are maintained with Cybernetica's support.
cells.note: The Justice Ministry's own information systems directorate led the instant criminal-record service that went live on 1 November 2026, with no contractor named, so a system built by government staff went live. No three systems are named as run wholly in-house, so not 5.
